purpose: Define Node Content API so graph engine owns nodes, ports and edges while content plugins supply bounded node content types such as `comment` and `example` without redefining graph semantics.

topics.name: Node Content API
topics.purpose: Define Node Content API so graph engine owns nodes, ports and edges while content plugins supply bounded node content types such as `comment` and `example` without redefining graph semantics.

semantics.engine_rule: Graph engine owns node identity placement, ports, edges and graph lifecycle.
semantics.content_rule: Content provider owns only the payload/presentation semantics of its declared node content type.
semantics.extension_rule: New content type registers explicit identity, schema and rendering/editing semantics.
semantics.port_rule: Content type does not invent ports/edges unless explicitly allowed by its node type contract.
semantics.inert_rule: Comment/example content is inert and cannot execute operations by itself.
semantics.separation_rule: Node content and canonical semantic target identity remain distinguishable.

invariants.rule: Editor surfaces project and mutate canonical semantics only through explicit validated operations; editor layout or widget state never becomes semantic or runtime authority.
